title: EEVblog #1132 - The 3 Cent Microcontroller!
summary: Dave Jones of EEVblog looks at a sub-3-cent microcontroller from Padauk and other obscure Chinese manufacturers. He shows how to find such parts and where to buy them in stock.
why: Cited as the go-to demo that full microcontrollers now cost about three cents, replacing things like the 555 timer.

quote.text: Dave Jones' EEVBlog recently posted a video on cheap microcontrollers (<0.03USD)
